payload.posture: Read Ephesians 2:1–10 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states death, mercy, grace, and a created way of life. You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins, For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
